title: Repeatable tests
summary: A repeatable test gives the same result with the same inputs. Pass changing values in instead of hiding the current time in the calculation.
introduction: A repeatable test gives the same result with the same inputs. Pass changing values in instead of hiding the current time in the calculation. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A repeatable test gives the same result with the same inputs. Pass changing values in instead of hiding the current time in the calculation.

blocks.code:
const isLate = (due, today) => today > due;
console.log(isLate(5, 6));
blocks.title: Repeatable tests

blocks.text: The result is always true for these inputs. The test does not depend on today's real date.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A test that depends on the real clock can change overnight.
For more detail later, use this [Software Testing further reading](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn_web_development/Extensions/Testing).
